improvements: Replaced the invented ridge band with two georeferenced public-domain USGS 3DEP elevation grids.

remainingGaps: The two33 × 49 grids omit fine peaks and are a bounded portion of the Olympics rather than the full horizon.
The highest sampled elevation is below some published named summits; no synthetic summit was inserted.
Snow/rock colour and atmospheric visibility remain procedural rather than a dated seasonal observation.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.
